test_objective: Verify that PATCH HTTP requests can be done with "application/merge-patch+json" as Content-Type

test_cases.name: 044_02_01 Endpoint /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}
test_cases.doc: Verify that PATCH HTTP requests can be done with "application/merge-patch+json" as Content-Type
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Update Subscription and 
Header['Link'] contain the context 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/merge-patch+json' and
Payload defined in file 'subscriptions/fragments/subscription-update-sample.json'
}
